title: EzNeth
description: Craft Netherite Ingots with 1 Netherite Scrap and 1 Gold Ingot
body: EzNeth makes Netherite Ingots easier to craft by using 1 Netherite Scrap and 1 Gold Ingot. Simple, lightweight, and easy to use on any 1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.2, 1.21.3, 1.21.4, 1.21.5, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11 server.
